summary: Hawthorn Bancshares (HBI) filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of FSC Bancshares (FBI) via a two-step merger, followed by a bank-level merger of Farmers State Bank into Hawthorn Bank. FBI shareholders received $73.7099 cash and 2.1823 HBI shares per share, totaling 413,101 HBI shares and $13,953,000 cash. The transaction closed September 3, 2026, per the April 29, 2026 Reorganization Agreement. HBI issued a press release on September 4, 2026. The S-4 registration was declared effective July 21, 2026. Watch for integration progress and any post-merger adjustments.
